headline: Trump says he is "close" to a trade agreement with Mexico after meeting with Sheinbaum at APEC
summary: Trump said a trade agreement with Mexico was about to be concluded, but he noted continued concern over drug cartel activity in Mexico. The remarks followed a meeting with Sheinbaum at APEC.
why: Mexico is one of the largest trading partners of the United States, so US-Mexico tariff and trade arrangements affect manufacturing supply chains and the peso.
original_headline: Trump afirma que está "cerca" de un acuerdo comercial con México tras reunión con Sheinbaum en APEC
